title: The Waiting Room — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Spanish French life philosophy language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
I've been to the waiting room more times than I can say
The one at the doctor's office and the one at the end of the day
There's always a magazine from fourteen months ago
And a man who needs the chair next to you — you're the last to know

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La sala de espera me conoce bien
[The waiting room knows me well]
He esperado más tiempo del que puedo contar
[I have waited longer than I can count]
Una revista del año pasado sobre la silla
[A magazine from last year on the chair]
Y el tiempo se estira como una maravilla
[And time stretches like a wonder]

[Chorus — English]
The waiting room knows something I don't know
It knows that time is optional and patience is a show
The waiting room has magazines from years that have gone by
And everyone inside is practising the art of the goodbye
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
La salle d'attente est une philosophie complète
[The waiting room is a complete philosophy]
On attend sans savoir pourquoi on attend
[We wait without knowing why we wait]
Le temps ici est différent du temps dehors
[Time here is different from time outside]
La salle d'attente sait ce que nous ignorons encore
[The waiting room knows what we still ignore]

[Outro — All three languages]
The waiting room knows… La sala de espera sabe… La salle d'attente sait
We're all waiting — Todos estamos esperando — Nous attendons tous
That's my boy
